folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B310: research, intention and routine attention
folds.body:
P1–P5, T1–T6, A1–A14, I1–I5 and all comparison/mode/food tables were fully content-reviewed. Preserve the useful distinction between an intention, supplied outside information, the character's actual knowledge, demonstrated understanding, competence, a faculty, equipment and social permission. A typed ambition is neither instant scientific truth nor a reason to deny an otherwise supported goal. Interface translation can name the next supported investigation without silently teaching facts from the player's text. The hypothetical historical-child example establishes no particular historical feasibility or source law.

The old one-realm/one-prestige milestone boundary is retired under the October24 scope direction. The old paused-work statement is not a current process or dispatch status. The substantive recommendation to compress solved upkeep is consistent with later AD52/ACR direction, while its particular initiative modes, food roles and proposed comparisons retain their proposal status. Do not turn this into a universal autonomous-character veto, a mandatory hunger layer or permission for unselected closed-browser consequences.

Knowledge, mastery, practice and access may develop separately or arrive together through a supported broad grant. A new hypothesis is not true because generated; an inconclusive experiment is not a refutation. A valid method without stock can remain known and unusable. Failed work may teach something real without a compulsory consolation reward. Repetition can genuinely improve competence; AD52 removes avoidable repeated input while preserving actual growth, time, materials, costs, support and consequential choice. Once a routine is solved, material changes can return control rather than force a recurring acknowledgement button. Bounded goal execution stays within the chosen budget, known methods and stop conditions; no silent spending or information transfer follows from interest alone.

Three contrasting starts and the recommended idea/food comparison remain authoring aids, not an extra prerequisite before every useful first consumer. Snapshot admission needs coherent resolved facts, but this does not forbid safe conditional generation or supported independent axes. Relevant current owners retain authority over source acquisition, bodies, items, study, jobs and clocks. No research subsystem, talent, food policy, source fact, player-to-character channel, simulation mode or runtime was changed by this document review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B310: villain seats, independent selves and dated evidence
folds.body:
All 214 lines were content-reviewed, including both E1–E14 tables, VX1–VX10, OX1–OX12, ES1–ES7, EM1–EM12, WF1–WF17, BF1–BF12 and S1–S5. The truncated central output was reread before full coverage was recorded. Fifteen requested dossier paths across fourteen works are this historical lane's inspected dependencies, not fifteen new reads here. Its SHOWN labels remain attributed dossier observations; source cutoffs, damaged compilations, testimony, inferred relations and explicit absent notes are preserved. Neither source coverage totals nor subsequent sequel classifications fill an earlier book's unqualified mechanism.

The old first-realm/first-prestige boundary is retired; current selected developer and book-world priorities govern sequence. Folder inventory, frozen source headers, inactive-world statuses, old priority lists and all seven ES source inspections are dated snapshots. They do not prove present module constraints or missing functionality. In particular, the later intro owner records reciprocal-return delivery and a merged developer probe, while ordinary starts, general NPC continuity and every identity contract remain separate questions. No linked brief, private dossier, primary chapter or runtime seam was freshly verified by reading this comparison.

VX preserves the person who acted, the public name, the office's obligations, audience belief and present intent as distinct. Useful service can survive through an actual replacement input; removing one harmful input need not collapse every service or require continuing the harm. Beneficiaries and victims can reach a compatible settlement. A dangerous expert can supply bounded useful work without a compulsory redemption or recruitment. A fearful title can be helpful locally without proving intent. Inherited autobiographical detail, procedural competence, accusations and verified history need their own provenance. The player's new decisions do not erase real earlier harm or force an unsupported attribution to a replacement subject.

OX/EM preserve actual creation cutoff, independent minds and bonds, shared or private resource owners, control terms and information channels. A common soul need not imply one controller; separate bodies need not imply separate fuel. Accurate copied memory need not confer lived participation, but a source's actual continuity/fusion law can supply a stronger relation. Losing identity-linked access need not remove intrinsic competence. Detecting a face, trace or marker answers its actual proposition, not every origin question. Independent-person status does not by itself grant automatic offline activity, while actual supported broad telepathy, control or exact recognition need not be weakened by generic uncertainty taxes.

Template exclusion, death, history persistence, accessible destination, resident survival and completed rescue are different claims. Author-published counterfactuals are not automatically reachable universes. A cross-history unique object needs the particular source contract; ordinary branch-local goods do not become singletons by analogy. Creation/recovery/transfer needs complete relevant state and durable settlement rather than a parent ID, reset list or hash alone. Summary-memory display caps must not erase durable causes or rights; the historical32-entry validator limit is not current source inspection. A single active-visit validation does not settle every multi-body clock policy.

The twelve conceptual records are not a schema or a requirement to build all identity systems before the first chosen start. Reuse the incumbent actor, stock, knowledge, job, relationship and time owners; add the selected causal binding where it has a useful consumer. Current compatibility direction qualifies historical missing-source retention suggestions, without retroactively changing their date. S1–S5 and the hypothetical original-world fits remain available ideas, with source-wide or absent-dossier questions resolved only when relevant. No world selected, dossier acquired, NPC history invented, save changed, runtime gate added or source truth disclosed by this review.
